# third_party CMake configuration

# Find or build each backend

# ncnn
if(BENCHMARK_NCNN)
    if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ncnn)
        add_subdirectory(ncnn)
        set(ncnn_FOUND TRUE)
        message(STATUS "Found ncnn")
    else()
        message(WARNING "ncnn not found, please add as git submodule")
        set(BENCHMARK_NCNN OFF)
    endif()
endif()

# MNN
if(BENCHMARK_MNN)
    if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/MNN)
        set(MNN_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(MNN_BUILD_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(MNN_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(MNN_BUILD_BENCHMARK OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        add_subdirectory(MNN)
        set(MNN_FOUND TRUE)
        message(STATUS "Found MNN")
    else()
        message(WARNING "MNN not found, please add as git submodule")
        set(BENCHMARK_MNN OFF)
    endif()
endif()

# TNN
if(BENCHMARK_TNN)
    if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/TNN)
        # Build as shared library to avoid symbol conflict with MNN cpuinfo
        set(TNN_BUILD_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(TNN_BUILD_BENCHMARK OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(TNN_BUILD_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        # Enable ARM assembly optimizations for Android
        if(ANDROID)
            set(TNN_ARM_ENABLE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
            set(TNN_ARM82_ENABLE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
            # Force CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR for TNN ARM detection
            set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR "aarch64")
            message(STATUS "TNN: Enabled ARM assembly optimizations")
        endif()
        add_subdirectory(TNN)
        set(TNN_FOUND TRUE)
        message(STATUS "Found TNN")
    else()
        message(WARNING "TNN not found, please add as git submodule")
        set(BENCHMARK_TNN OFF)
    endif()
endif()

# TensorFlow Lite
if(BENCHMARK_TFLITE)
    if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tflite_extracted)
        set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
        add_library(tensorflow-lite INTERFACE)
        target_include_directories(tensorflow-lite INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tflite_extracted/headers)
        # Use library from extracted AAR
        set(TFLITE_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tflite_extracted/jni/arm64-v8a/libtensorflowlite_jni.so)
        if(EXISTS ${TFLITE_LIB})
            target_link_libraries(tensorflow-lite INTERFACE ${TFLITE_LIB})
            set(TFLite_FOUND TRUE)
            message(STATUS "Found TensorFlow Lite: ${TFLITE_LIB}")
        else()
            message(WARNING "TensorFlow Lite library not found at: ${TFLITE_LIB}")
            set(BENCHMARK_TFLITE OFF)
        endif()
    else()
        message(WARNING "TensorFlow Lite not found")
        set(BENCHMARK_TFLITE OFF)
    endif()
endif()

# QNN
if(BENCHMARK_QNN)
    # QNN needs to be downloaded from Qualcomm Developer Network
    # Put extracted QNN SDK in third_party/QNN/
    if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/QNN/include/QNN)
        add_library(qnn INTERFACE)
        # Add both include paths: QNN headers reference subdirectories
        target_include_directories(qnn INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/QNN/include)
        target_include_directories(qnn INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/QNN/include/QNN)
        if(ANDROID)
            set(QNN_LIB_PATH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/QNN/lib/arm64-v8a/libQnnSystem.so)
        else()
            set(QNN_LIB_PATH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/QNN/lib/arm64-v8a/libQnnSystem.so)
        endif()
        if(EXISTS ${QNN_LIB_PATH})
            target_link_libraries(qnn INTERFACE ${QNN_LIB_PATH})
            set(QNN_FOUND TRUE)
            message(STATUS "Found Qualcomm QNN SDK: ${QNN_LIB_PATH}")
        else()
            message(WARNING "QNN SDK found but library not found at: ${QNN_LIB_PATH}")
            set(BENCHMARK_QNN OFF)
        endif()
    else()
        message(WARNING "QNN SDK not found in third_party/QNN/, please download from https://qpm.qualcomm.com/")
        set(BENCHMARK_QNN OFF)
    endif()
endif()

# ONNX Runtime
if(BENCHMARK_ORT)
    if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/onnxruntime)
        add_library(onnxruntime INTERFACE)
        target_include_directories(onnxruntime INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/onnxruntime/include)
        if(ANDROID)
            set(ORT_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/onnxruntime/lib-android/aarch64/libonnxruntime.so)
        else()
            find_library(ORT_LIB NAMES onnxruntime PATHS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/onnxruntime/lib)
        endif()
        if(EXISTS ${ORT_LIB})
            target_link_libraries(onnxruntime INTERFACE ${ORT_LIB})
            set(ONNXRUNTIME_FOUND TRUE)
            message(STATUS "Found ONNX Runtime: ${ORT_LIB}")
        else()
            message(WARNING "ONNX Runtime library not found for target architecture")
            set(BENCHMARK_ORT OFF)
        endif()
    else()
        message(WARNING "ONNX Runtime not found")
        set(BENCHMARK_ORT OFF)
    endif()
endif()

# Apache TVM
if(BENCHMARK_TVM)
    set(TVM_ROOT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tvm)
    if(ANDROID)
        set(TVM_LIB ${TVM_ROOT}/build-android/libtvm_runtime.so)
    else()
        set(TVM_LIB ${TVM_ROOT}/build/libtvm_runtime.so)
    endif()

    if(EXISTS ${TVM_LIB})
        add_library(tvm_runtime INTERFACE)
        target_include_directories(tvm_runtime INTERFACE ${TVM_ROOT}/include)
        target_include_directories(tvm_runtime INTERFACE ${TVM_ROOT}/3rdparty/dlpack/include)
        target_include_directories(tvm_runtime INTERFACE ${TVM_ROOT}/3rdparty/tvm-ffi/include)
        target_link_libraries(tvm_runtime INTERFACE ${TVM_LIB})
        set(TVM_FOUND TRUE)
        message(STATUS "Found TVM Runtime: ${TVM_LIB}")
    else()
        message(WARNING "TVM Runtime not found")
        set(BENCHMARK_TVM OFF)
    endif()
endif()
